text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I won... I won the Derby—

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Skyyyyyyy!! Way to goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-!? Grandpa!? You came!?

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Look, that's my grandkid! Cute, right? And 
so strong, yeah!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: U-Ugh, a-ah, yes sir...!

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
She made my dream come true! Sky is the 
best granddaughter everrr!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Umm, please stop, it's embarrassing~... 
Ah, you can't hear me, can you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. "My dream," huh—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Congratulations, Sei-chan. Truly... 
congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...B-But next time—in the Kikuka Sho... 
I'm going to win...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Even with shattered dreams, she's 
already looking forward.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're really strong, Spe-chan.

Seiun Sky brilliantly won the Derby. Yet 
the public's evaluation of him remains—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky got the better of her this time! 
But Special Week still has plenty of room 
to grow...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That girl's strength is the real 
deal. She's gonna transform over the 
coming summer! I'm definitely keeping my 
eyes on Spe-chan next time too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan really is popular, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She possesses consistent ability, so if 
they factor in her growth potential too, 
we'll be totally outmatched.
choice_data_list: But Sky's the one who won
But Sky's the one who won

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But... I also agree that Spe-chan 
still has plenty of room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I guess I gotta get even stronger by the 
Kikuka-sho~... Just kidding.

Heading toward the final leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka-sho, 
summer arrives for the Umamusume.
